3␟Gerrhi: The region the Greek writer Herodotus named as the Scythian royal burial ground, where dead kings were entombed in great pits. It was probably somewhere along the lower Dnieper River in modern Ukraine.
6␟Api: The earth goddess of Scythian religion, ranked just below the supreme fire goddess Tabiti and paired with the sky father Papaeus. Most of what the Scythians believed about her is lost.
